AUTH_MISSING.title: No key yet
AUTH_MISSING.body: You haven't added a key for {provider} yet. Add one and you're generating.
AUTH_MISSING.claudePrompt: In my JenAI Studio project I haven't added a key for {provider} yet. Which provider should I sign up for to get free credits, and how do I get the key and paste it into the app's settings?

AUTH_INVALID.title: That key didn't work
AUTH_INVALID.body: {provider} rejected the key. It's probably wrong or expired.
AUTH_INVALID.claudePrompt: In JenAI Studio my {provider} API key was rejected as invalid. Help me generate a new key and paste it into the app's settings.

INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS.title: You're out of credits
INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS.body: {provider} says there's no credit left on this key.
INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS.claudePrompt: In my JenAI Studio project, provider {provider} says I'm out of credits. Walk me through topping up, or switching to a provider that still has free credits.

RATE_LIMITED.title: Too fast — take a breath
RATE_LIMITED.body: {provider} got too many requests at once. Wait a moment and try again.
RATE_LIMITED.claudePrompt: JenAI Studio hit a rate limit on {provider}. Explain what that means and how to space out my batch so it doesn't happen again.

BAD_REQUEST.title: Something in the request was off
BAD_REQUEST.body: {provider} couldn't read this request. The model or a setting may not be supported.
BAD_REQUEST.claudePrompt: In JenAI Studio a generation on {provider} with model {model} failed as a bad request. Help me figure out which setting is unsupported and fix it.

MODERATION_BLOCKED.title: This prompt was blocked
MODERATION_BLOCKED.body: {provider}'s content filter blocked this prompt. Try rewording it.
MODERATION_BLOCKED.claudePrompt: My prompt in JenAI Studio was blocked by {provider}'s content filter. Help me reword it so it passes while keeping the same idea.

PROVIDER_DOWN.title: The model is busy
PROVIDER_DOWN.body: {provider} isn't responding right now. It usually passes on its own.
PROVIDER_DOWN.claudePrompt: JenAI Studio got a 'model busy' or server error from {provider}. Should I retry, wait, or switch to a different model?

TIMEOUT.title: The model is busy
TIMEOUT.body: This one took too long. Try again in a moment.
TIMEOUT.claudePrompt: A generation in JenAI Studio on {provider} timed out. Should I retry, wait, or switch to a faster model?

UNKNOWN.title: Something went wrong
UNKNOWN.claudePrompt: A generation in JenAI Studio on {provider} with model {model} failed with an error I don't understand. Here are the technical details — help me figure out what to do.

PERSON_IMAGE_BLOCKED.title: Blocked — real person in the image
PERSON_IMAGE_BLOCKED.body: {provider} blocked this because the reference image looks like a real person (a privacy/likeness filter). Rewording the prompt won't help — the block is on the image itself. Try a different model or provider, or use a stylized / character-sheet version of the person instead of a real photo.
PERSON_IMAGE_BLOCKED.claudePrompt: A generation in JenAI Studio on {provider} was blocked because the reference image may contain a real person. Rewording won't help. Help me either switch to a model/provider that allows real-person references, or turn the person into a usable stylized character reference.
